radosc.name: Joy
radosc.appraisal: Something good is here or happening — lightness of heart, up to euphoria. Without the object of play (Amusement) and without satiety (Contentment).

rozbawienie.name: Amusement
rozbawienie.appraisal: Something is funny — humor, laughter, the lightness of play (GEW Amusement).

ekscytacja.name: Excitement · Energy
ekscytacja.appraisal: The body running high: the tension of anticipation (“it’s about to happen”) or pure, objectless vitality.

ciekawosc-i-naped.name: Curiosity
ciekawosc-i-naped.appraisal: Something unknown draws attention and raises questions.

zaangazowanie.name: Engagement
zaangazowanie.appraisal: Absorbed in an activity — flow, focus, sunk into the doing.

determinacja.name: Determination
determinacja.appraisal: A goal ahead of me and the will mobilized to reach it.

pewnosc-i-mistrzostwo.name: Confidence
pewnosc-i-mistrzostwo.appraisal: Faith in my own agency — “I can handle it” (prospective, before acting).

duma.name: Pride
duma.appraisal: Looking back at an achievement — mine or a loved one’s — with satisfaction and head held high.

nadzieja-i-spelnienie.name: Hope
nadzieja-i-spelnienie.appraisal: A good future seems possible — an optimistic lean forward.

zaskoczenie-i-zachwyt.name: Surprise
zaskoczenie-i-zachwyt.appraisal: Something unexpected — positive astonishment (without delight: that lives in Admiration).

bliskosc.name: Closeness
bliskosc.appraisal: Love and the pull toward closeness directed OUTWARD — I love, I cling, I want to be near; being loved lives here too, because it energizes.

podziw.name: Admiration · Inspiration
podziw.appraisal: Greatness, beauty or excellence beyond me lifts me and pulls me upward (GEW Admiration + awe).

spokoj-i-wyciszenie.name: Calm · Safety
spokoj-i-wyciszenie.appraisal: No threat and no disturbance — balance, stillness, ground under my feet.

odprezenie-i-swoboda.name: Relaxation · Relief
odprezenie-i-swoboda.appraisal: The tension has drained away — ease in body and mind; relief when it lifted just now.

zadowolenie-i-komfort.name: Contentment · Comfort
zadowolenie-i-komfort.appraisal: It is good enough — satiety, comfort, a quiet “I lack nothing”.

zaduma.name: Reverie
zaduma.appraisal: Gentle immersion in thoughts, memories or daydreams.

wdziecznosc.name: Gratitude
wdziecznosc.appraisal: I received something good — from someone, from fate — and I appreciate it.

wzruszenie.name: Being moved
wzruszenie.appraisal: A sudden, soft stirring by beauty, kindness or the weight of a moment — a lump in the throat, sometimes tears (kama muta).

czulosc.name: Tenderness
czulosc.appraisal: Warmth and softness toward a particular being — gentleness, heartfelt care.

troska-i-empatia.name: Compassion · Care
troska-i-empatia.appraisal: Another being’s fate matters to me — their suffering or need resonates in me.

przynaleznosc-i-akceptacja.name: Belonging · Acceptance
przynaleznosc-i-akceptacja.appraisal: A group or a person takes me in — I am part of it, seen and supported.

uznanie-i-szacunek.name: Recognition · Appreciation
uznanie-i-szacunek.appraisal: Others see my worth — they value, respect and appreciate what I bring.

stres-i-przytloczenie.name: Stress · Overwhelm
stres-i-przytloczenie.appraisal: Demands exceed my resources — strain under a load that keeps pressing.

szok.name: Shock
szok.appraisal: Something sudden shook me — it does not fit in my head yet; the world stopped for a moment (an event).

zamet.name: Confusion · Torn
zamet.appraisal: I cannot piece it together or choose — disorientation, being torn between conflicting options or feelings (a process).

niepokoj-i-zmartwienie.name: Anxiety · Worry
niepokoj-i-zmartwienie.appraisal: Something may go wrong — a vague or future threat circles in the background.

strach-i-panika.name: Fear · Panic
strach-i-panika.appraisal: The threat is here and now — the body wants to flee or freezes.

irytacja-i-frustracja.name: Irritation · Frustration
irytacja-i-frustracja.appraisal: Something grates on me or blocks my goal — mounting irritation at the world’s resistance.

gniew.name: Anger
gniew.appraisal: Someone crossed a line, an injustice happened — energy to push back.

pogarda-i-zazdrosc.name: Jealousy · Envy
pogarda-i-zazdrosc.appraisal: Someone has something I want for myself — from neutral wanting to ill will toward the one who has it.

wstret.name: Disgust
wstret.appraisal: Something repels me — physically or morally I want to pull away.

pogarda.name: Contempt
pogarda.appraisal: Someone stands lower in my eyes — I look down on them, denying them worth (moral, interpersonal).

upokorzenie.name: Humiliation
upokorzenie.appraisal: Someone (or something) exposed my flaw, lack or mistake before others — dignity down, and the feeling also turns outward, toward the perpetrator (anger, injustice).

wstyd-i-wina.name: Shame · Embarrassment
wstyd-i-wina.appraisal: My behaviour, trait or mere exposure was (or could be) received badly — embarrassment and the urge to vanish, turned inward: from light abashment to deep shame (cold, deflating, withdrawing).

wina-i-zal.name: Guilt · Regret
wina-i-zal.appraisal: I did something wrong — responsibility for the act and regret, the urge to repair (behavioural).

zranienie.name: Hurt
zranienie.appraisal: Someone I care about caused me pain — trust breached, the bond aches; from a fresh sting to long-chewed bitterness.

smutek-i-zal.name: Sadness · Dejection
smutek-i-zal.appraisal: Loss or letdown — a weight on the heart, the world loses colour; from the blues to devastation.

beznadzieja-i-rozpacz.name: Helplessness · Despair
beznadzieja-i-rozpacz.appraisal: I have no influence — no way out and no hope in sight; arms drop.

zwatpienie-i-rozczarowanie.name: Discouragement
zwatpienie-i-rozczarowanie.appraisal: The drive has run dry — I no longer believe trying is worth it (a process, facing forward).

rozczarowanie.name: Disappointment
rozczarowanie.appraisal: I expected something good and it did not come — a letdown about something concrete (pointwise, facing back).

samotnosc-i-wykluczenie.name: Loneliness · Exclusion
samotnosc-i-wykluczenie.appraisal: No bond — I am alone, passed over, abandoned or a stranger among people.

tesknota.name: Longing
tesknota.appraisal: I miss someone or something that was good — a wistful pull toward the absent.

zmeczenie-i-wypalenie.name: Fatigue · Burnout
zmeczenie-i-wypalenie.appraisal: Resources spent — from needing rest to burnout from chronic stress.

apatia-i-znudzenie.name: Apathy · Boredom
apatia-i-znudzenie.appraisal: Nothing draws me — listlessness and boredom; I still feel something (boredom, blandness), but nothing sparks desire.

pustka.name: Emptiness
pustka.appraisal: Feeling switched off — numbness, “I feel nothing” (a clinically significant signal).

ui.title: Emotions
ui.dunno: I don't know what I feel
